summary: Phase 3 of the 9-phase Route B plan (plans/01_labelled-framework.md) is the gated adequacy-bridge hardest node, bounded to 2 agent dispatches. Dispatch 1 fully closed Lemma 6.2.2's hard direction (sorry-free, axiom-clean) but did not attempt Lemma 6.1.2/6.2.3 (the tree internalization), diagnosing that it needs a reified finite-tree scaffold. This dispatch (2 of 2, FINAL per the plan's bound) found and corrected a significant transcription error inherited by the plan/report 01 -- Simpson's internalizing formula uses BOX (not diamond) as the outer ancestor-to-target telescoping connective, verified directly against the source PDF (pages 109-112, read via the Read tool since pdftotext garbles the glyphs) -- and, building on that correction, produced a substantial verified (sorry-free, axiom-clean) reusable scaffold (LTree reified tree type, star/Star internalizing formulas, and a complete K-necessitation combinator toolkit: box_mono1, box_mono2, wrapClosed, Star_imp1, Star_imp2, Star_append) sufficient, on paper, for 11 of the 15 NIKAx induction cases -- including orE/efq, which Simpson himself hedges as 'quite intricate' but which turn out to be tractable once the corrected formula and toolkit are in place. The one remaining case, NIKAx.diaE (one of Simpson's own four modal rules, written out in full in the source), has a genuinely new obstruction: its `z` parameter is not scoped relative to `x` by the bare Lean type, requiring an unproven well-scopedness invariant plus Simpson's Figure 6-2 dissection tree-surgery, neither of which was completed. Per the plan's explicit 'bounded attempt: 2 dispatches, do not open a third', Phase 3 is now marked [BLOCKED] permanently. Nothing is landed under Cslib/ -- no sorry, no new axiom, fully additive (only specs/ artifacts changed).

Built and fully verified a reified finite-tree type (LTree), the corrected internalizing formulas (star/Star), and a complete combinator toolkit (box_mono1, box_mono2, wrapClosed, Star_imp1, Star_imp2, Star_append) via CSLib's existing parameterized deduction theorem. blockers.why_stuck: NIKAx.diaE's `z` parameter (the rule's conclusion label) is not provably scoped relative to `x` (the diamond-fact's label) by the bare Lean type -- Simpson's own Fitch-style natural-deduction notation enforces this implicitly, but the inductive Prop encoding does not. Closing this needs a new, unproven well-scopedness invariant plus mechanizing Simpson's Figure 6-2 'dissection' tree-surgery argument for when z is a proper ancestor of x. Neither was completed.
